name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude: discovery with features, end-to-end process flows and test cases; architecture and design-system stages; sprints sliced through whole user journeys with a plan→build→independent-QA triad; Playwright, Cypress and Selenium tests you can watch live, with accessibility checks and saved logins; private test reports; user-reviewed manuals with real screenshots per persona and level; screen-change diffs per release.
